mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, is_enabled AS enabled FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE tool_name = #{toolName} AND is_enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, is_enabled AS enabled FROM mcp_dynamic_tool ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_dynamic_tool (tool_name, tool_description, input_schema, groovy_script, linked_request_keys, is_enabled) VALUES (#{toolName}, #{toolDescription}, #{inputSchema}, #{groovyScript}, #{linkedRequestKeys}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_dynamic_tool SET tool_description=#{toolDescription}, input_schema=#{inputSchema}, groovy_script=#{groovyScript}, linked_request_keys=#{linkedRequestKeys}, is_enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcp_dynamic_tool WHERE is_enabled=1
